name: Muslim People
overview: Scripture reveals the origin of Ishmael, the forefather of many Muslim people, as the son of Abram and Hagar (Genesis 16:15). The Old Testament foretells the coming of a Prophet like Moses from among the brethren (Deuteronomy 18:15,18), but the New Testament clearly identifies Jesus Christ as the true fulfillment, born of the Holy Spirit (Matthew 1:18), the eternal Word who was with God and is God (John 1:1), and who declared His preexistence before Abraham (John 8:58). This establishes Jesus not merely as a prophet, but as the divine Savior central to God’s redemptive plan.
